messages.audit.logs.introduction: Audit logs let you track user access to your OpenSearch cluster and are useful for compliance purposes.
messages.audit.logs.storageInstruction: Configure the output location and storage types in {opensearchCode}. The default storage location is {internalOpenSearchCode}, which stores the logs in an index on this cluster.
messages.security.getStarted.addBackends.title: Add backends
messages.security.getStarted.addBackends.body: Add authentication {authc} and authorization {authz} information to {configFile}. The {authc} section contains the backends to check user credentials against. The {authz} section contains any backends to fetch backend roles from. The most common example of a backend role is an LDAP group.
messages.security.getStarted.createRoles.title: Create roles
messages.security.getStarted.createRoles.body: Roles are reusable collections of permissions. The default roles are a great starting point, but you might need to create custom roles that meet your exact needs.
messages.security.getStarted.mapUsers.title: Map users
messages.security.getStarted.mapUsers.body: After a user successfully authenticates, the security plugin retrieves that user's roles. You can map roles directly to users, but you can also map them to backend roles.
messages.security.getStarted.intro: The OpenSearch security plugin lets you define the API calls that users can make and the data they can access. The most basic configuration consists of these steps.
messages.security.getStarted.auditLogs.title: Optional: Configure audit logs
messages.security.getStarted.purgeCache.title: Optional: Purge cache
messages.security.getStarted.purgeCache.body: By default, the security plugin caches authenticated users, along with their roles and permissions. This option will purge cached users, roles and permissions.
messages.security.getStarted.multiTenancy.title: Optional: Multi-tenancy
messages.security.getStarted.multiTenancy.body: By default tenancy is activated in Dashboards. Tenants in OpenSearch Dashboards are spaces for saving index patterns, visualizations, dashboards, and other OpenSearch Dashboards objects.
